content: 'Eritseu mɨpaɨ katiniuta'ani: —Yawé niukieya xekeneu'enie, mɨpaɨ kanaineni: “'Uxa'a 'ipaɨpauka Tsamariya kitenieyaritsie xekaniyɨwawekuni xeikakuniyari xeminanenikɨ tɨriku harinayari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane xeipɨratayarikɨ meta huta kakuniyari tsewara yaxeikɨa xeipɨratayarikɨ”.

Ti'aitame parewiwameya mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Mɨpaɨ pepɨkahaineni. Xɨka Yawé naime muyuawitsie reuyepiexɨanike, yaxeikɨa 'atsipɨkatiyɨni. 'Eritseu mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —'Ekɨ pekaninierimɨkɨ 'ahɨxitekɨ, peru mɨkɨ 'ekɨ pepɨkatitikwani.
Tsamariyatari kememɨte'utawikwei

Hikɨ mɨkɨ tukaritsie mana yunaukatɨ teɨteri nawi kwiniyayari mehexeiyatɨ kiekari kitenie mekaniutitekaitɨni. Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniuyuxatɨani: —¿Keteteyurie 'uwa te'utitetɨ, teta'ikwewatɨ xeikɨa temɨkwinikɨ?

Xɨka kiekaritsie teheutahaxɨani yakɨxeikɨa tepɨyɨni. Mana tekanekwikuni haakakɨ hipame wahamatɨa, xɨkata 'uwa teyuhayewani, yaxeikɨa tepɨkwini. 'Aixɨa pɨyɨni tepuhu tsiriyutsixi mematitei, temetayetuanikɨ. Xɨka mekatatsihekwini, 'atepu'uwani, mexɨka metatsihekwini, yaxeikɨata tetekwinikekai hakakɨ.
Hikɨ 'ukuyɨreku mekanekɨne, peru kepauka memeta'axɨa tsiriyutsixi memakuteitsie, manari teɨteri hawaikɨ mepɨkatehetitekai.

Mɨpaɨ pɨtiɨyɨkai, Yawé puwarutimariutakai tsiriyutsixi puwaru'enitsitɨakai kaxetate kuyaxa miemete meta kawayutsixi wayuariya, wa'atɨ yumɨiretɨ kuyaxi 'umepɨtehahu hepaɨ mekateniu'enanani. Hikɨ mɨkɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniuyukaxatɨani: «Yurikɨ xɨari 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, te'aitamete hetitsixi meta 'ekipitutari pɨtiwarupitɨa pɨratakɨ mɨkɨ memɨtatsitakwinikɨ».

'Ayumieme, 'ukuyɨreku mekaniyuta'una tsiriyutsixi mete'uku'eirieka yu'ixuriki kiyarite meta yukawayutsixi metatsiere yupuxuri. Mana memakutekai mekateniuku'eirieni yaxeikɨa reukupikame, mekaniyuta'una memɨkakwi'iwakɨ.

Kepauka nawi kwiniyayari memexeiya memɨta'axɨa tsiriyutsixi memakutekai, xeime 'ixuriki kiiyarita mekaneutahaxɨani. 'Ari mete'ukwaka mete'u'ieka, muwa mekatenewayetɨni pɨrata, huru meta kemarite, hikɨ mɨkɨ tinaime mekateniuti'awieta. Hutariekata me'u'axɨaka xeimetata mekaneutahaxɨani, muwata yaxeikɨa waɨkawa mekateniutaxeiya piinite meta mɨkɨ mekateniuti'awieta.

Hikɨ mɨpaɨ mekateniuyuxatɨani yunaitɨ: —Neuxei 'aixɨa tepɨkateyurie. Pauyewetse matsi 'ikɨ 'aixɨa mɨti'ane temɨtetaxatakɨ, peru wa'atɨ tepɨte'anukanama. Xɨka kahekɨareyuke yate'utiyuani, tahetsie pɨrahɨiyani. Hikɨmɨ hikɨ kwitɨwa tekanihuni ti'aitame kiiya manuwe, yatemɨtehetaxatakɨ.

Hikɨ mekanekɨne kiekaritsie mana mekateniwaretaxatɨani kitenie tehɨwemete. Mɨpaɨ mekateniwarutahɨawe: «Tame tsiriyutsixi memakuteitsie tekanekukɨnixɨani, peru teɨteri mepemawe waniuki tepɨkahe'eni. Kawayutsixi xeikɨa meta puxuri mana mepewɨtɨkatei. Meta 'ixuriki kiyarite yaxeikɨa pɨrekuwetɨka hakewa metiwewiyaxɨa».
Hikɨ kiekari kitenie tehɨwemete, kememɨte'uxatɨariekai karima mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ, ti'aitame kiita paitɨ mekaniye'axɨani.

Tsepanetɨ muyɨwikai, ti'aitame mana kiekame 'anukukeka mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe yuparewiwamete: —Xekeneneu'eni nepɨtixetaxatɨani, mɨkɨ tsiriyutsixi kememɨteyuriku tahepaɨtsita. Mɨpaɨ memɨtematekɨ, tame temɨyehaakakwitɨwekɨ, 'ayumieme mekananuku'uni memakuteitsie yupiinite mete'uku'eirieka, peru mɨkɨ mekaneyu'awietani yeuta paitɨ. Mɨpaɨ mepɨte'uyuri temɨwayekɨnekɨ mɨpaɨ memɨtatetiwiyakɨ meta memeutahaxɨanikɨ takiekaritsie.

Xewitɨ kuyaxi tiwa'aitɨwame mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Hipatɨ teɨteri meke'anuyekɨne, meyu'auxɨwime kawayutsixi mewarahapatɨ 'akuxi 'uwa memuyuhayewatɨwe. Xɨka mehekwi'iwa 'ikɨ, yaxeikɨata tameta tanaitɨ 'ixaheritsixi tekanikwi'iwakuni. Tsiparatsɨ tepɨwaranunɨ'ani yatemɨtehetimanikɨ.
Hikɨ 'ana yapauka teɨteri hutame kaxeta mekaniwarukuha'aritɨani me'enawɨtɨakame kawayutsixi, hikɨ ti'aitame tsiriyutsixi memakutekaitsie kaniwarenɨ'ani, yamemɨtehetimanikɨ memetinierekɨ.

Mɨkɨ Kurutani paitɨ mewaruyeikirɨmetɨ mekaniyenuaxɨani, 'ana mɨkɨ mekateniukaxeiya naime huye 'utɨa kemarite meta naime tita mɨrahete mexɨitɨarikakɨ tsiriyutsixi memɨte'ukaxɨri. Hikɨ nɨ'ariekate mehakunuaxɨaka ti'aitame yamekateniutaxatɨani,

hikɨ 'ana tsamariyatari mekanayekɨne tsiriyutsixi wapiinite metetipinike. Yawé niukieya kemainekai, mɨpaɨ mekateniutinaneni, xeikakuniyari tɨriku harinayari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane mekaninanekaitɨni xeipɨratayarikɨ, meta huta kakuniyari tsewara yaxeikɨa xeipɨratayarikɨ.

Ti'aitame mɨpaɨ yuparewiwame katiniuta'aitɨakaitɨni kiekari kitenieyaritsie mɨtitahɨkakɨ, peru mana teɨteri mekanitimu'utara memɨyumɨirekaikɨ, 'anari mɨkɨ kaniutatɨmaiyarieni, mɨpaɨ katinaye'atɨarieni tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme kemainekai kepauka ti'aitame meikuxeitsie.

Mɨpaɨ katiniɨyɨni, tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme ti'aitame mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawekaitɨni: «'Uxa'a ximeri 'ipaɨ 'upaukakaku Tsamariya kitenieyaritsie, pɨyɨweni mɨnanaiyani xeikakuniyari tɨriku harinayari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane xeipɨratayarikɨ, meta huta kakuniyari tsewara yaxeikɨa xeipɨratayarikɨ»,

'ana ti'aitame ti'uximayatsiriwame mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨkaitɨni: «Mɨpaɨ pepɨkahaineni. Xɨka Yawé naime muyuawitsie reuyepiexɨanike, yaxeikɨa 'atsipɨkatiyɨni». Tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawekaitɨni: «'Ekɨ peninierimɨkɨ 'ahɨxitekɨ, peru mɨkɨ 'ekɨ pepɨkatitikwani».
Hikɨ mɨpaɨ katinaye'atɨarieni: teɨteri meyumɨiretɨ mekanitapɨna kiekari kitenie, hikɨ mana kaniumɨni.
